title: Part 1: Profile badge progress, clickable leaderboard modals, games played column, paginated match history

requirements.text: In the Profile tab, display all available badge definitions (not just earned ones). For each unearned badge, show a progress bar and a count label (e.g., '3/10 wins') indicating the user's current progress toward earning it. Earned badges should remain visually distinct (e.g., full color) while unearned badges appear dimmed with the progress indicator overlaid.

quotes: make available badges visible and show users progress towards unearned badges in profile tab

acceptanceCriteria: Profile tab shows all badge definitions, both earned and unearned
Unearned badges display a percentage progress bar
Unearned badges display a count label such as '3/10 wins'
Earned badges are visually distinct from unearned ones
Progress is computed from the user's existing stats/match history data

requirements.text: Make player rows in the Leaderboard tab clickable. Clicking a player opens a modal overlay showing that player's profile: a bar chart of wins/losses over time, current and best win streaks, and their earned badges.

quotes: have users be clickable in leaderboard tab and bring up their profile showing bar chart, streaks, and earned badges

acceptanceCriteria: Each player row in the leaderboard is clickable
Clicking opens a modal (not a page navigation)
Modal shows a bar chart of the selected player's wins and losses over time
Modal shows the selected player's current win streak and best win streak
Modal shows all badges earned by the selected player
Modal can be dismissed to return to the leaderboard

requirements.text: Add a 'Games Played' column to the Leaderboard tab table, showing each player's total number of games (wins + losses).

quotes: add games played column in leaderboard tab

acceptanceCriteria: Leaderboard table includes a 'Games Played' column
Value is calculated as wins + losses for each player
Column is visible alongside existing wins, losses, win %, and streak columns

requirements.text: Replace the current 5-entry match history limit in the Profile tab with a fully paginated match history list. Users should be able to page through all of their historical match records.

quotes: full match history with pagination (beyond last 5)

acceptanceCriteria: Match history in the Profile tab shows more than 5 entries
Pagination controls (next/previous or page numbers) allow browsing all records
Each page shows a reasonable fixed number of entries (e.g., 10 per page)
Loading state is shown while fetching additional records

constraints: Do not modify files listed in frontend.immutablePaths
All Motoko logic must remain in the single backend/main.mo actor
Do not implement chat emoji reactions or admin analytics in this build — those are Part 2
nonGoals: Navigating to a dedicated player profile page (modal only for now)
